I opened **PR #47**, which fixes three of the four problems from my last comment. It doesn't add automatic session reopening. `npm run check` passes (375 tests).

**1. A fetch can no longer move the ref a run is writing to.** On the runner, a run now keeps its thread on `refs/pi-action/threads/<n>` and its working-tree snapshots on `refs/pi-action/worktrees/<n>`. It still pushes them to `refs/pi/threads/<n>` and `refs/pi/worktrees/<n>` on origin, so nothing changes for anyone reading threads. A command like the one I ran, `git fetch origin '+refs/pi/*:refs/pi/*'`, now only touches refs the run doesn't use.

This also matters because `docs/threads.md` tells users to add `+refs/pi/*:refs/pi/*` to their fetch config. With that setting, any plain `git fetch` the agent ran would have caused the same failure.

The changes are in `src/storage/sync.ts` (new `localRef`/`localCompanionRef` options and a `liveRef()` helper), `src/thread.ts`, `src/worktree.ts` and `src/push.ts`.

**2. A failed session is reported instead of dropped.** When waiting for an answer fails, `ThreadConversation.track()` now:
- posts a `❌ pi Error` comment that includes the full cause, e.g. *"Session failed after a storage error; close and reopen it: Git storage is poisoned and must be reopened: Ref … moved: expected …, found …"*;
- adds 😕 to the comment;
- fails the step, so the run shows red instead of green.

**3. The save step no longer warns when origin is already ahead.** If origin already has the local commits, the `Save pi thread state` step logs "already saved". Before, it warned "another writer moved it".

**New tests:**
- An agent that runs `git fetch origin '+refs/pi/*:refs/pi/*'` and then delet

es `refs/pi/threads/42` during a run still gets its answer posted and pushed.
- An agent that deletes the run's own ref gets the error comment, 😕 and a failed step.
- The save step leaves an ahead origin alone.
- `GitSync` fetches into, and clears, its own local refs.

I also updated `docs/threads.md` ("Protection against conflicts") and `docs/how-it-works.md`.
